people.name: Cindy Riggs
people.notes: Official site describes extraterrestrial/star-being channeling among several traditions. Sep 22,2026 publisher episode explicitly describes Orion channeling.

people.name: Rachel Chamness
people.notes: Official written masterclass identifies trance channeling. Guide/spelling variants kept as written.

people.name: Toni Ghazi
people.notes: Official site describes trance-channeling a Mantis conduit. Antares is called a galaxy by the practitioner; retained as an attributed label, not astronomy.

people.name: Sam the Illusionist
people.notes: Public persona Sam; full human name not established. Site archive last displayed2024 does not date current YouTube uploads.

people.name: Blossom Goodchild
people.notes: Official site distinguishes off-world Federation of Light from White Cloud, a spirit guide. The two should not both be treated as ET species.

people.name: Debbie Solaris
people.notes: Galactic Akashic reader/historian, including guidance attributed to Arcturian/Pleiadian sources; interview footage is not automatically a trance-channeling performance.

people.name: Elizabeth April
people.notes: Official site offers a GFL video catalog and public YouTube route. Public live listings also include teaching; no assumption every upload is channeling.

people.name: Ais Esther
people.notes: Dark Star Channeling identifies its main claimed source as Orion being Zariyah. Name from source testimonials and YouTube result attribution; no further private identity inferred.

people.name: Krista Raisa
people.notes: Practitioner/publisher sources associate Orion Council with her; historical staycurly and Ezoterra branding retained without assuming a current upload schedule.

people.name: Christine Nowinski
people.notes: Official website identifies the trance-channeling practitioner; her public posts describe multi-entity sessions. Client claims remain attributed, not verified.

people.name: Ivan Teller
people.notes: Official site describes extraterrestrial channeling; podcast host biography dates his claimed start to March2015. No current exact video upload dates established here.

people.name: Magenta Pixie
entities: White Winged Collective Consciousness of Nine
people.notes: Official site presents higher-dimensional Nine. Some other publishers associate them with Sirius; this does not establish an astronomical origin.

people.name: Marina Jacobi
people.notes: Official material advertises live channeling and advanced ET themes. Quantum terminology is the practitioner's framing, not a validated scientific result.

people.name: Sal Rachele
people.notes: Official site identifies a conscious channel. Founders playlists include Brian Scott readings; these must not be mislabeled Sal speaking.

people.name: Suzanne (Suzy) Ward
people.notes: Matthew is presented as her deceased son, alongside other off-planet sources. Narrated republications are distinct from Suzy performing channeling.

people.name: Sheldan Nidle
people.notes: Historical and written-material lead. Current personal video performance/activity not established by this workstream.

people.name: Mike Quinsey
people.notes: Named written-channeling lead from the translation directory. No secure original personal YouTube account/video was established here.

people.name: Anne Tucker
people.notes: Broader channeling context. The reviewed official biography emphasizes angelic sources; not automatically counted as an ET-specific medium.

people.name: Lee Harris
people.notes: Broader higher-dimensional/guide context. The Zs are not automatically classified as an ET civilization.

people.name: Steve Rother
people.notes: Broader guide/mixed context; official site associates Lilith with Earth origins and Eris. Do not infer every Group recording is ET-specific.

people.name: David Nicholas
people.notes: GFL founder self-described channeler; source says standalone channel started2022. Finished messages use produced narration, including AI voices. No alias merge with Dave Akira established here.

people.name: Dave Akira
people.notes: Specific Oct5,2026 text credits this name. Possible relationship to founder David Nicholas remains unresolved; not a second verified unique human.
